items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Leroy Smith had been there 11 years, in Connie's Inn.

ctx.x: Yeah, strictly white, no colored. Leroy Smith had been there 11 years, in Connie's Inn. So you see, he looked like he had a grip on it, and nobody -- and I never

went there and never went in there. Colored people didn't go in there, strictly white people. And I said, where you going, Connie's Inn? He say, yeah. He says, I want you to rehease with us. He named a place and he had a rehearsal band and all like that.
